evidence.appropriate: a small seed with a sprout leaning in on two low eyes: a friend first, a character without a story
evidence.distinctive: no competitor uses a seed; not an owl, monster, egg or book; the leaning teardrop silhouette is its own
evidence.simple: one teardrop, one leaf, two dots; 15 anchors; drawable in four strokes
evidence.legible: silhouette holds at 16 px; the eyes fade below 24 px but the seed-and-leaf shape still reads; Pip reads at the 120 px lockup
evidence.adaptable: one-colour 64 and 32 px panels hold; reverse holds; small and favicon tiers enlarge the eyes
evidence.timeless: no trend shape; a plain character with no gradient or sparkle
evidence.universal: mirrored panel reads the same; rotated 90 reads as a fish or tadpole, a faint secondary reading only when turned
evidence.clear: description search (seed character with leaf and dot eyes, kids app) found no matching mark; full knock-out in refinement
evidence.congruent: round shape, balanced but leaning, low complexity, open frame, small and light like the name's front vowel; matches every target but weight runs heavy
evidence.system: horizontal, stacked, symbol, compact, small and favicon all built; rationale draft in critique.md
